fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

First downloaded on 2026-09-24 at about 22:32Z; re-downloaded at 2026-09-24T23:11Z, at least 30 minutes after the first, with matching byte count and SHA-256 (750729 bytes). The live original was downloaded at 21:59Z (750,729 bytes, same SHA-256), and again with a cache-busting query at 2026-09-24T23:21Z (750729 bytes, sha256 80feb09418ad9ba8..., identical). The base32 SHA-1 of these bytes (ZXIM5LIAZIWOH65ANR66WZFIZXQ2QASZ) equals the digest the Internet Archive recorded for every capture of both ANC URLs from 2021-11-09 to 2025-09-17. The independent check downloaded it again at 2026-09-24T23:22-23:31Z with plain curl (no Accept-Encoding, no decoding), at least 49 minutes after the kept copy, with the same byte count and SHA-256; the base32 SHA-1 of the bytes equals the Internet Archive's CDX digest for the capture. The researcher's kept copy was re-hashed for this packet with the same result.
provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of the ANC's original page, captured at 2021-11-09T16:18:24Z (before the 7 September 2026 cutoff); that form replays the archived bytes unchanged and is used in place of any live copy (the old www.anc.org.za pages are no longer served, and the ANC's current anc1912.org.za site regenerates its HTML pages per request). The response identity recorded here was confirmed by downloads at least 30 minutes apart (see stability_check). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response.
